definitions.explanation: The act or ability of perceiving, understanding, or recognizing something; awareness or comprehension.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧⟦さを→さ：noentry⟧{認識|にんしき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to recognize the seriousness of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧{認識|にんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: He and I have different perceptions.

examples.japanese: ⟦AI→AI：07764_eeai⟧⟦による→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧{認識|にんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}している→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧。
examples.english: AI facial recognition technology is advancing.

notes:
{認識|にんしき} covers both the act of recognizing or perceiving something and the resulting awareness or understanding. As a noun it refers to one's perception or understanding of a situation; as a suru verb it means to recognize or become aware of something.

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive) — takes を to mark what is recognized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {認識|にんしき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recognize, to be aware of
- {認識|にんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have an awareness of
- {認識|にんしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧: to have a naive/insufficient understanding
- {認識|にんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧: to deepen one's understanding
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧{認識|にんしき}: facial recognition
- ⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧{認識|にんしき}: voice recognition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧: understanding (deeper comprehension)
- ⟦{自覚|じかく}→自覚：05319_jikaku⟧: self-awareness (awareness of one's own state)
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: consciousness, awareness (broader, more general)
